Istor is one of the wolves in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.
“
Careful! No stone-scent. No stone-sound. Strange-stone here.
„
— Istor

Involvement

Act One

Istor can be found lying on the cavern ground in the Zhentarim Basement. If spoken with via  Speak with Animals, Istor warns the party away from a strange stone nearby, which he has been tasked to guard.
